title: A high dust emissivity index β for a CO-faint galaxy in a filamentary Lyα nebula at z = 3.1
question: Is the dusty galaxy LAB18.b in the SSA22 Lyα nebula LAB18 a typical DSFG, judged from its molecular gas depletion time and dust emissivity index β?

data.bands: Band 3 (CO J=4-3, 2.7 and 3 mm continuum); Band 7 850 um from earlier data
data.sensitivity: continuum rms 5.9 uJy/beam (3 mm), 8.7 uJy/beam (2.7 mm)

evidence.quote: ALMA Band 7 850 $\mu$m ((cite: ao18); Matsuda et al. in prep)

external_data.citation: (cite: ao18); Matsuda et al. in prep

what.value: SPIRE 250 um flux density and confusion noise

evidence.quote: applied a source confusion noise for photometry error (cite: kato16)
we adopted luminous submillimetre galaxies (SMGs) median CO $J=4-3$ luminosity to CO $J=1-0$ luminosity ratio of $r_{41}=0.41\pm0.07$ (cite: bothwell13)
$\kappa_{850}$ is assumed to be $\kappa_{850}=3.2$ cm$^{2}$ g$^{-1}$ (cite: demyk17)

recipe.method: CASA clean with natural weighting on pipeline-calibrated data; 3 mm and 2.7 mm line-free continuum and continuum-subtracted cube at 80 km/s
Single Gaussian fit to the spectrum for z_CO; imfit on the integrated map with primary beam correction for flux

recipe.goal: Fit dust SED for T_d, beta, L_IR
recipe.method: Single-temperature optically thin modified blackbody chi2 fit to SPIRE 250 um, ALMA 850 um, 2.7 mm, 3 mm

recipe.goal: Derive SFR, dust mass, GDR, depletion time
recipe.method: SFR=1.0e-10 L_IR (Kennicutt98, Chabrier IMF); dust mass from 3 mm flux with kappa_850=3.2; tau_dep = M_gas/SFR

not_stated_but_needed: line-free channel ranges used for continuum
SED fitting code, priors and grid
rest frequency used for the L'CO conversion
Band 7 850 um flux density and SPIRE 250 um flux values
missing_for_reproduction: SED photometry values for SPIRE and Band 7
score_reason: Short letter with clear derived quantities and public data, but missing imaging and fitting details and input photometry.
rediscovery_reason: Public ALMA data, simple recipe and numeric results (z_CO, L'CO, M_gas, beta), though SED inputs must come from other papers.
